title: Canopus /dev/canopus transport v2 envelope (CAN-P0-008)
description: Single versioned wire format on /dev/canopus and WearPacket L2 0x43. CPC1/CPS1 are not accepted on the device. CanopusConnect (ADR-CAN-009) opcodes: 19=CONNECT_SEND, 20=CONNECT_LISTEN (phone to device), 21=CONNECT_MESSAGE (device to phone, message_kind 3 EVENT, request_id 0); they are handled before the Manager dispatch. Native staging opcodes: 15=BEGIN (176-byte CMI2), 16=WRITE (u32 offset + up to 508 bytes), 17=FINISH, 18=ABORT. QUERY_DEVICE payload is 84 bytes with target_id at +36. The layout is fixed little-endian; a wire buffer is never dereferenced as a packed C struct.

total_size.description: must equal header_size + payload_size and fit the caller buffer

opcode.description: CANOPUS_CMD_*; a response echoes the request's opcode

request_id.description: client-monotonic; 0 is reserved for unsolicited events
